title: Convocatoria de Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado 2026 (National Postgraduate Scholarships 2026)
official_source: Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación (SECIHTI) - Dirección General de Becas y Apoyos a la Comunidad Científica y Humanista
duration: Full length of the registered postgraduate programme, in complete months, without exceeding the maximum term set in the scholarship regulation
description: The Convocatoria de Becas Nacionales para Estudios de Posgrado 2026, issued by the Secretaria de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnologia e Innovacion (SECIHTI), provides monthly economic support and ISSSTE medical service to students enrolled in postgraduate programmes registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados.

title: Horatio Alger Association National Scholarship
official_source: Horatio Alger Association of Distinguished Americans
program_type: Need-based scholarship from a non-governmental organisation
duration: Four-year undergraduate scholarship, renewed annually through the degree
description: The Horatio Alger Association is a US non-profit organisation dedicated to helping high-school students who face significant financial obstacles and demonstrating that a college education is attainable through scholarships, mentoring and other programs. This scholarship programme supports US high-school juniors who can demonstrate strong academic potential, perseverance in overcoming adversity and service to their community, aiming to help them attend a US college or university.

title: Building Brighter Futures: Bursaries and Scholarships (Indspire)
program_type: Indigenous student bursary and scholarship programme (charitable fund)
duration: Skilled-trades stream: certificate or diploma programmes of one to four years. For academic programmes the duration follows the student's enrolment; applications must be resubmitted each academic year.
description: On the strength of a conviction that education is the key to empowering Indigenous communities, Indspire is Canada's largest charity supporting Indigenous post-secondary students. Since 1996, through its Building Brighter Futures: Bursaries, Scholarships and Awards Program, it has awarded 313,535,200 CAD to more than 9,500 recipients, and in 2026 alone it awarded 33,336,500 CAD to more than 9,500 applications.

title: Perimeter Institute PhD Residency Program Award
funding: Doctoral funding package (university salary plus Perimeter top-up)
duration: Up to Term 12 (typically four years / 12 academic terms)
description: Perimeter Institute awards a PhD Residency Program Award to doctoral students admitted to a partner Canadian university and supervised by a Perimeter faculty member, associate faculty member or senior researcher. The official page states that resident PhD students are financially supported through their home university, typically for four years or twelve academic terms, and that the Residency Award adds top-up funding up to $30,000 per year, calculated after fees and tuition, on a September to August academic year, until Term 12. title: OAS-AUWCL Scholarship Program (American University Washington College of Law LL.M.)
official_source: Organization of American States, General Secretariat (with American University Washington College of Law)
program_type: Regional intergovernmental scholarship programme (OAS Partnerships Program for Education and Training, PAEC)
duration: 2-3 semesters (LL.M. in International Human Rights and Humanitarian Law); 2-10 semesters (LL.M. en Derechos Humanos y Derecho Humanitario); 9-18 months (LL.M. in International Arbitration and Business Law)
description: The OAS-AUWCL Scholarship Program awards a 50% tuition waiver for the LL.M. programmes of American University Washington College of Law in Washington, D.C., under the OAS Partnerships Program for Education and Training (PAEC). It is open to citizens and permanent legal residents of any active OAS member state other than the United States who hold a JD from an ABA-accredited US law school or an equivalent foreign law degree and are admitted to an AUWCL LL.M. programme. program_type: Research institute doctoral mobility scholarship administered under the CAPES-Global.Edu programme
duration: 6 months (7 scholarships) or 9 months (3 scholarships), selected at application (item 2.1)

official_source: Centro Maria Sibylla Merian de Estudios Latinoamericanos Avanzados (CALAS)
duration: 2 to 3 months of in-residence research at a CALAS regional centre, starting between March and June 2027
description: CALAS, the Maria Sibylla Merian Centre for Advanced Latin American Studies, together with Bielefeld University, offers two research fellowships of two to three months for qualified researchers to work in residence at one of its Latin American regional centres: the Central America and the Caribbean centre in San Jose, Costa Rica, or the Andean centre located at FLACSO in Ecuador. Fellows sit within the transdisciplinary research programme "Creando horizontes: aceleraciones, transformaciones, emergencias".
